page_title: ANG 2-0 AUX | Angers v Auxerre 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Auxerre are seeing far more of the ball now.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) commits a rough challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
87' 2 - 0 Goal! Prosper Peter (Angers) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
86' 3:3 – the corner kicks stats.
84' The substitution is prepared. Lamine Sy (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marvin Senaya.
83' The substitution has been made. Assane Diousse (Auxerre) has replaced Elisha Owusu.
82' Substitution. Sidiki Cherif makes way for Harouna Djibirin (Angers).
82' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Amine Sbai and he is replaced by Prosper Peter (Angers).
79' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 3:3.
77' Here comes a substitution. Lassine Sinayoko is given a rest as he is replaced by Gideon Mensah (Auxerre).
77' Amine Sbai (Angers) plays a through ball but overhits it.
75' Substitution. Louis Mouton makes his way off the pitch and Marius Courcoul (Angers) comes on as his replacement.
75' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Jacques Ekomie will be replaced by Florent Hanin (Angers).
73' Substitution. Rudy Matondo is replaced by Sekou Mara (Auxerre).
71' 1 - 0 Bad communication between Clement Akpa (Auxerre) and the goalkeeper led to an own goal. Thumbs down. Well, let's see if he can correct his mistake with a strike into the opponent's goal.
70' Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre) has tested the patience of referee Abdelatif Kherradji and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' 6:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
67' Amine Sbai (Angers) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
65' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is penalised for holding. Abdelatif Kherradji signals a set piece.
64' Yassine Belkhdim will be replaced by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
63' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
61' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
59' Himad Abdelli (Angers) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
57' 53:47 – the latest ball possession ratio.
55' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Angers failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Amine Sbai (Angers) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
50' Angers keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
48' Himad Abdelli (Angers) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Donovan Leon.
46' Christophe Pelissier makes a half-time substitution. Josue Casimir comes on in place of Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Abdelatif Kherradji has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Looks like Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
43' Louis Mouton (Angers) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
41' A player from Auxerre commits a rough challenge. Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
39' Angers are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
36' Abdelatif Kherradji has a clear sight and sees a foul from Louis Mouton (Angers).
35' The resulting corner from Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) comes to nothing.
35' The cross into the penalty area from Kevin Danois (Auxerre) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
33' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Amine Sbai (Angers).
30' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Herve Koffi easily deals with the threat.
28' A lofted cross from Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
24' Angers keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
21' The possession of the ball – 52:48.
19' Angers take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is flagged for offside.

17' Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
16' The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
16' He should have scored! Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
14' That's a well-taken pass by Carlens Arcus (Angers). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
12' Angers string together a series of short passes.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Auxerre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Abdelatif Kherradji had an easy-decision to make.
6' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) will deliver the corner kick.
4' Angers players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
2' Auxerre are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The match has just started.
Angers will kick-off.
Abdelatif Kherradji got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
